layers.purpose: Supply traceable facts, claims, context and uncertainty.
layers.model_use: Only approved purpose- and role-filtered extracts; embedded commands remain untrusted data.

layers.purpose: Provide reviewed, versioned and executable business conditions.
layers.owner: Policy release service and accountable reviewer
layers.model_use: Explain the service decision; propose a draft candidate when a gap exists. Never self-publish or override a rule in prompt text.

layers.purpose: Constrain this buyer's permitted execution for a bound plan.
layers.owner: Authenticated human through trusted UI; mandate service
layers.model_use: Receive minimal state and permitted-action projections; cannot create the human principal, consume its challenge or extend its authority.

layers.purpose: Guide a bounded agent's research, tool selection, handoff and explanation.
layers.model_use: Selected by the runtime from a pinned reviewed release; can narrow available tools only.

enforcement_boundary: The tool gateway and deterministic business services must enforce identity, ownership, versions, policy, budgets, idempotency and payment state. Natural language and these metadata flags do not implement enforcement.
conflict_handling: Do not let a model decide authorization conflicts by textual instruction priority. Deny invalid authority; mark uncertain business facts and require the designated review path.
